responsibility: This header is the stripped-down system portability wrapper used by target libraries and runtime-side code rather than the full compiler proper. It arranges inclusion of standard headers or fallback declarations under inhibit_libc, defines GCC runtime-side assertion, alloca, cast, and null conventions, and includes filename helpers. Its responsibility is to provide a minimal, target/runtime-safe equivalent of system.h for code built with target macros and potentially without full libc headers.
